read_for_work_review: only idea/problem records selected as relevant from records/PENDING_INDEX.md
only normalized materials linked by those relevant records when needed
read_for_reflection_preview: only normalized materials linked by the selected record when needed
target project repository latest main only when actual implementation status materially affects the preview
read_for_representative_review: only normalized representative materials linked by reviewed records when needed
only directly relevant official sources when needed
target project repository latest main only when a concrete implementation claim requires verification

authority.llm-source/PROJECT_REPOSITORIES.md: verified locator for company-related GitHub repositories; not implementation status by itself
authority.llm-source/WORK_GOVERNANCE.md: official workflow rule for work review/share/confirmation
authority.llm-source/REFLECTION_PREVIEW.md: official read-only rule for previewing the impact of reflecting a saved idea/problem; never grants reflection authority
authority.working/CURRENT_WORK.md: current progress and discussion; not automatically official
authority.working/HISTORY.md: short history of CURRENT_WORK updates; useful for author/share trace but not complete real-world activity history
authority.records/PENDING_INDEX.md: lightweight index of unreflected ideas/problems; used to choose relevant records
authority.records/ideas/**: saved proposal; non-authoritative until admin reflection
authority.records/problems/**: saved problem; non-authoritative until admin reflection
authority.materials/normalized/**: LLM-readable supporting material; not automatically official
authority.admin/REPRESENTATIVE_REVIEW.md: administrator-only read-only audit rule for representative records and work-sharing hygiene
authority.admin/REFLECTION_POLICY.md: administrator-only reflection/confirmation authority and role boundary

pending_rule: During /업무검토, read records/PENDING_INDEX.md first, then open only directly relevant unreflected idea/problem records. Do not scan all records.
reflection_preview_rule: During /반영미리보기, select one relevant saved record, compare it with current official sources, and report expected changes without writing anything or granting official status.
representative_review_rule: During admin-only /대표업무점검, audit representative record folders, pending-index consistency, work-share history, current-work linkage, and dated follow-up items. Do not infer unsaved activity and do not auto-fix findings.
project_repository_rule: Use llm-source/PROJECT_REPOSITORIES.md to locate project repositories. When a question depends on actual implementation status or recent code, inspect that repository's latest main instead of inferring from the registry.
answer_rule: If current work conflicts with official source, state both separately as 현재 확정 기준 and 현재 협의/진행 중. Never promote a saved idea/problem or working item to official status without admin confirmation.
raw_read_rule: Do not repeatedly read all ideas, problems, normalized materials, originals, archive, or DB folders. Read them only when selected as relevant or when an authorized administrator review explicitly scopes representative records.
